data.current_description: Query transfers with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
data.summary_suggestion: List transfers with filtering and pagination
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve a paginated list of transfers for the requesting organization with optional filtering and sorting. Supports filtering by transfer type (TED_OUT, TED_IN, P2P), status (CREATED, PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, etc.), date range (fromDate, toDate), and amount range (minAmount, maxAmount). Pagination defaults to 50 items per page with a maximum of 100 items. Enforces tenant isolation - only returns transfers belonging to the requesting organization. Use this for transfer history queries, reconciliation, or building transfer dashboards.
